## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so it now contradicts the code. That should be fixed. The code change itself is a one-constant edit, and the updated parser test asserts the new default.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README timeout default to 60 seconds — With `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." Users who read the README will expect 30 seconds when they run without `--timeout`, but they will get 60. — Users who rely on the README will misjudge how long requests wait before timing out. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
